title: Hearing is already mature at birth and favors a human voice
summary: MedlinePlus says hearing begins before birth, is mature at birth, and that the infant prefers the human voice.
body: The MedlinePlus sensory list says hearing begins before birth and is mature at birth, and that the infant prefers the human voice. The page was reviewed on 1 January 2025 and cites pediatrics textbook chapters. It is a general statement, not the result of a newborn hearing screen and not a claim that every sound is equally interesting.

sources.title: Infant - newborn development
sources.author: MedlinePlus
sources.note: Supports hearing beginning before birth, mature at birth, with a preference for the human voice.
